post_clip.description: A person on a scooter (striped shirt) dismounts and approaches another parked scooter (purple), appearing to interact with it while the rider is absent or distracted; this matches the 'covert theft' pattern of taking unattended items. The individual then returns to their scooter and prepares to leave, suggesting possible theft of an item (e.g., bag, helmet, or phone) from the unattended vehicle.

The first man reacts by turning and looking after him, suggesting a possible snatch theft (e.g., phone or wallet) from an unsuspecting/distracted person, consistent with covert snatching without weapon or overt threat.
